positions.name: RetroFormatAdoption
positions.frame: which retrospective format does the team run its sprint retros in, and what did it replace?
positions.why: The single statement carries a whole frame on its own: it names the adopted format, its three sections, and the format it replaced last sprint. It is a settled team-process decision declared in the collective 'we'. No existing narrative leaf or stratum covers team process, so `under` is omitted.
